card.name: Woule
card.profile: Woule (roule) is one of the seven gwoka base rhythms and the only one in triple time (3/4), a swaying, airy waltz-like 'rolling' rhythm sometimes danced with a scarf (foulard); it is often described as a 'Creole waltz' used to charm and mimic/satirize the European masters, and is also associated with repetitive work like graj. Played on the ka drums (two boula plus make) with chacha and responsorial Creole song, danced in the lawonn at lewoz gatherings (Wikipedia: Gwo ka; Ziloka).
card.insight: Woule's waltz-like triple meter is widely cited as evidence of European ballroom influence creolized into the gwoka repertoire.
